notes.title: Some Important Bug Fix
notes.content:
Several bugs found by community fixed now. Please update game before playing.
[list]
[*] Somehow Geothermal Planet was not activating in the Space Navigator. Fixed it. If it's not visible in your game even after you completed Nuclear Planet missions just land onto the Contact Station in Nuclear Planet. If you see final message of Dr. Jekyll, Geothermal Planet should be enabled in the navigator.
[*] Save system was not working after a while because of local storage quote. Added cleanup code to fix it. Please save once to let it clean up.
[/list]

I believe it should work normally 😁

Thanks for your feedback and support 🙏

notes.title: Geothermal Planet + Save Slots!😱
notes.content:
Hey pilots!
We have an update for you!

- New Planet: Geothermal Planet! Hope you like our new design. 😉

- Save slots: You can load previous save points in case you stuck somewhere. After you update the game you need to start a new game because I overhauled all the save system and it was not possible to make it compatible with the older version. Sorry for that but I'll do my best to keep things compatible for the next updates.

- UI bug fixes: Some text elements were not fitting in some languages.

- Small additions and fixes suggested by community. Thanks for your feedback 🙏

Folks! We really do need your support to survive and make great games. This is only possible with your support. So, if you like this project please leave positive review on Steam which will trigger the algorithm to show this game to more people.

Thanks, enjoy! 🤘

Enjoy!

notes.title: Playtest started! Join now, test it, give feedback! 🚀😎🤘 Yeah!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
This one is very important update for the game. This is beginning of our playtest storm! Getting closer to the Early Access release. Your feedback is invaluable for us!

New features and updates are available for playtesters. Let's see what we have:

[list]
[*]We added tutorial sequence in the beginning of the campaign. It should be much more convenient for onboarding. 
[*]Reverse thrusters! Finally we have reverse thrusters! Oh my god!
[*]Junkyard Planet and Industry Planet were added. Actually Junkyard was already in the previous demo but now it's only available on playtest from now on. Waiting your feedback!
[*]Spaceship made stronger.
[*]Fuel consumption reduced. 
[*]Ultra stupid teleport bug finally fixed! Will stay fixed forever! (I can't believe it!)
[*]Some UI improvements applied. 
[*]Some more bugs are fixed.
[/list]

Hope you like this new build. Waiting your feedback on Discord! Join the Playtest Community to test latest features and participate the development!

Game on!

notes.title: Let's Farm Some Crystals!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Here is a small update on SpaceKraft!

[list]
[*] Volcano feature was broken we fixed it. Now you can farm crystals by plugging volcanoes on the planets.
[*] F9 shortcut toggles wide camera. Actually we made it for debug purposes but then realized that it's quite useful during gameplay when you wanted to take a look around.
[/list]

New updates are on the road!
Hope you like it 😉
